## Summary

P26.2 — **source expansion** (ticket
`docs/tickets/P26.2__source-expansion.md`, SOURCES.2), stacked on
`devin/p26-1-scheduled-ops`.

All nine sources the P25.6 completeness triage promoted to
`promote`-pending-implementation are now **real connector paths** — every one
mapped to an existing class connector where one exists — and the registry grew
**121 → 142** under a recorded discovery sweep. Five sources flip to
`ingestion_permitted=true` under **GL-GATE-06** (the 2026-09-16 blanket
permission for resolved-clear licences); the two that do not resolve —
DocumentCloud's per-document licences and CourtListener's FLP membership
agreement — stay gated with the honest reason on their rows.

`sig-connectors validate`: **142 registered / 43 permitted / 43 loadable /
0 missing vocabulary / 0 disposition drift.**

## What changed

- **`procurement.py`** — the agenda-platform connector class gained an
  agenda-index path driven by a `platform` config key: **Legistar**
  (`webapi.legistar.com/v1/<tenant>/` — `/matters` + `/events`, supporting
  `event:`/meeting-body targets) + matter row-pair joins, **PrimeGov**
  (`<tenant>.primegov.com` v2 — `/api/v2/PublicPortal/search` meeting index;
  the `Document` capture kind → `evidence_artifact`), **CivicClerk**
  (`<tenant>.civicclerk.com` `/v1` — `/Events` index; `/Agendas` and
  `/Minutes` `publishedOnly` indices merged when retrievable); plus the
  **SAM.gov** `/prod/opps/v2/opportunities` procurement-notice path
  (`API-KEY-auth` marker; key resolution deferred to the fetch config).
- **`accountability.py`** — **OpenStates** `v3.openstates.org/bills`
  `bill_index` path (index-only evidence links, never bulk body text;
  `API-KEY`-auth note is keyed `api-key`) + **CourtListener** v3
  `/api/rest/v3/` targeted-lookup path (opinions → dockets → RECAP documents
  as `document_release` evidence links + raw fields).
- **`records.py`** — **DocumentCloud** released-document index path
  (project documents, `noindex=false` published rows only; summary +
  description + raw fields as release evidence).
- **`agency_registry.py` (new)** — **FBI CDE** agency-registry connector:
  `agencies.<state>` rows → `agency_registry_entry` claims preserving raw
  CDE fields; ORI/state/USAC emitted as **candidate identifiers** — no
  entity resolution (per ticket).
- **`runner.CONNECTOR_FOR_SOURCE`** maps all nine; their nine `promote`
  rows came out of `live_dispositions.toml` (mapped ∪ dispositions ==
  registry preserved); `connectors/__init__.py` registers
  `AgencyRegistryConnector`.
- **New vocabularies**: `agency_registry_vocab.toml`;
  `agenda_tenants.toml` tenant registry (seattle/chicago verified,
  lacity/oklahomacityok unverified).
- **`live_targets.toml`** rows for legistar ×2, primegov, civicclerk,
  sam_gov, openstates, courtlistener_recap, documentcloud,
  fbi_cde_agency_registry, eyes_on_flock CSV; **`api_allowlist.toml`**
  entries for the documented APIs (ADR-083);
  **`ops/cadence.toml`** rows for the seven newly-loadable live-target
  sources (`sig-ops cadence --check` OK).

## Flips (GL-GATE-06 — resolved-clear licences only)

`legistar`, `primegov`, `civicclerk` →
`LicenseRef-PublicAgenda-MeetingRecord` (municipal records/public agendas;
`civicclerk` `redistributable=false` pending counsel);
`sam_gov` → `CC0-1.0` (explicit `attribution_required=false` — no per-source
attribution by licence); `openstates` → `CC-BY-4.0`. All carry
`rights_reviewed_by="maintainer (delegated)"` + `rights_reviewed_on` +
`last_verified`; rights packets under `docs/build/reports/rights/`.

**Held gated:** `documentcloud` (per-document licence ambiguity,
UNDETERMINED) and `courtlistener_recap` (the free.law membership agreement's
binding usage conditions are an operator acceptance + credential act —
HG-03 class). Both have real connector paths and recorded exit-3 gate
refusals (no socket opened).

## Discovery sweep (+21 rows, all gated)

Nine US CCOPS/disclosure jurisdictions (oakland, berkeley, davis, cambridge,
boston, baltimore, nashville, grand rapids, somerville), four European
camera registries (denmark, amsterdam, austria, rotterdam), five
procurement platforms (bidnet_direct, periscope_s2g, publicpurchase,
demandstar, planetbids), plus powerdms_portals, swagit, opengov_procurement.
Every row: `ingestion_permitted=false`, rights-packet skeleton under
`docs/build/reports/rights/`, and a `live_dispositions.toml` row
(`reference` where the rights basis is pre-review, `mirror` where the
index itself is probeable without license terms). Pre-review probes
recorded: denmark/amsterdam/austria open data portals; grand rapids and
somerville full rosters; baltimore/nashville document indices.
